findings.rationale: The security group allows unrestricted ingress on TCP port 22 (SSH), exposing administrative access to the internet.
The security group permits unrestricted ingress on TCP port 3306 (MySQL), exposing the database to potential unauthorized access.

findings.control: defense-in-depth: public access block neutralizes an anonymous grant
findings.rationale: An S3 bucket policy grants anonymous read access, but this exposure is mitigated by a public access block at the bucket level.
